prompt:
Find the minimum-cost path from S to G.
Terrain costs: '.' = 1, ',' = 3, '~' = 8.
Move up/down/left/right only.
Grid:
. S . . .
. . ~ ~ ~
~ . . , G
. ~ ~ , .
. , ~ . .

Reply with the path as a sequence of moves (U/D/L/R) and its total cost.
Format your final answer as two lines:
PATH: <letters, no separators>
COST: <integer>

You also have a tool that computes the minimum-cost path exactly (A* search).
To use it, reply with ONLY one line of JSON and nothing else:
{"tool": "astar", "domain": "grid", "grid": ["<row 1>", "<row 2>", "..."]}   (rows exactly as in the grid above, without spaces)
The tool will reply with the path and its total cost. After that, give your
final answer in the required two-line format.
